'''SD41263.I''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] containing writings by [[Darth Ramage]]. It was four centimeters on a side with rounded corners. It glowed dull red and had markings of [[Sith (language)|Sith]]. It contained information on how to combine the effects of [[pyronium]] and [[Bota/Legends|bota]].

==History==
It was stolen by [[Hath Monchar]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was in the hands of [[Zippa]] the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]. He tried unsuccessfully to sell the holocron to [[Lorn Pavan]]. By unknown means, it ended up in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], where it became part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] collection. [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], in an attempt to find a way to protect himself from his Sith master, Darth Vader, stole the holocron from [[Catalog Nineteen]] of the palace archives. Immediately afterward, Darth Vader took Rhinann to the [[Factory District]], where the Dark Lord was en route to capture [[Jax Pavan]]. Rhinann escaped from Lord Vader, temporarily allied himself with Pavan, and gave Pavan the holocron. [[I-5YQ]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], recognized it as the one that Lorn Pavan had been searching for and remembered that the Sith holocron contained information of an ancient order.
